title: Public Alert No. 03/2025 – Alert on the Sale of Counterfeit/Falsified Petsow Starnicillin (Ampicillin) 500mg found in Cameroon and Central African Republic
summary: NAFDAC warns of falsified Petsow Starnicillin (Ampicillin) 500mg, batch 023612, purportedly made by Petsow Laboratories Limited, circulating in Cameroon and Central African Republic. Genuine Starnicillin 500mg (NRN 04-7790) batch V2403001. Zonal offices directed to mop up in Nige
